events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Emil Lilleberg scored on a rebound with 95 seconds left to help the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Boston Bruins 2-1 on Saturday, snapping a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emil Lilleberg scores late as Lightning beat Bruins 2-1; Boston clinches playoff spot later

events.name: Ottawa Senators at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Ridly Greig scored a short-handed goal, Linus Ullmark stopped all 23 shots he faced and the Ottawa Senators shut out the New York Islanders 3-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators beat the Islanders 3-0, clinch a playoff spot after Red Wings lose

headlines.description: — Ilya Protas scored his first NHL goal and added two assists as the Washington Capitals beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 6-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ilya Protas scores first NHL goal, Capitals defeat Penguins, 6-3

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Anton Forsberg made 27 saves in his third shutout of the season, and the Los Angeles Kings greatly bolstered their playoff chances with a 1-0 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Artemi Panarin scores, LA Kings shut down Oilers 1-0 to boost their playoff chances

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Jesper Bratt’s scored his second goal with 3:34 left in the third period, helping the New Jersey Devils eliminate the Detroit Red Wings from the NHL playoff picture with a 5-3 win on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Wings eliminated from NHL playoff picture with 5-3 loss to Devils

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Jordan Kyrou, Cam Fowler and Alexey Toropchenko scored in the second period, helping the St. Louis Blues beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyrou and Fowler help the Blues beat the Blackhawks 5-3

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored a goal and added an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 2-1 victory over Minnesota on Saturday, locking the Wild into the third seed in the Western Conference for the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stamkos leads Predators past Wild 2-1, locking Minnesota into the West’s third seed

events.name: New York Rangers at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored a power-play goal midway through the third period and added an empty-netter in the final minute while Jake Oettinger made 22 saves for his fourth shutout of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the New York Rangers 2-0 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson scores twice, Oettinger earns shutout as Stars beat Rangers 2-0 and clinch 2nd in Central

headlines.description: — Jordan Staal scored and reached 20 goals in a season for the first time in a decade, and the Carolina Hurricanes killed four of five penalties in a 4-1 win over the Utah Mammoth on Saturday for their sixth win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Metropolitan champion Hurricanes beat Mammoth 4-1 for 6th win in 7 games

events.name: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Eetu Luostarinen and Mackie Samoskevich had a goal and two assists each as the Florida Panthers cruised past the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luostarinen, Samoskevich push Panthers past Maple Leafs 6-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Charlie Coyle scored twice as the desperate Columbus Blue Jackets rolled to a 5-2 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coyle scores twice, Blue Jackets stay in playoff hunt with 5-2 win over Canadiens

headlines.description: — Sean Couturier had two goals and an assist and Noah Cates added a short-handed goal and two assists to lead the Philadelphia Flyers to a 7-1 win over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Couturier and Cates have 3-point games to lead the Flyers past the Jets 7-1

headlines.description: — Nikke Kokko stopped 26 shots in his first NHL start and Matty Beniers scored his 20th goal of the season as the Seattle Kraken beat the Calgary Flames 4-1 Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kokko stops 26 shots in 1st NHL start as the Kraken beat the Flames 4-1

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Jack Eichel scored 1:19 into overtime, and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Saturday night to secure a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eichel scores in OT, Knights clinch playoff berth with 3-2 win over Avs

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Linus Karlsson scored in the sixth round of the shootout and the Vancouver Canucks put the San Jose Sharks on the brink of playoff elimination with a 4-3 win on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Canucks deal a blow to the slim playoff hopes for the Sharks with a 4-3 shootout win
